subject: [PATCH v4 02/14] NFSD: validate transport name in listener_set before serv creation

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch adds a validation check for the transport name in the listener_set function of NFSD before service creation. It ensures that only supported transport names (tcp, udp, and rdma) are accepted to prevent unknown names from triggering a request_module upcall under nfsd_mutex. The check is performed in the nfsd_nl_validate_listeners function, which runs before taking the nfsd_mutex lock. If an unsupported name is detected, it returns an error with a descriptive message indicating the offending attribute.
